blocks.content: Time has its own units, and they do not go in tens — there are 60 minutes in an hour and 60 seconds in a minute. Knowing these lets you convert time easily.
1 hour = 60 minutes, 1 minute = 60 seconds, and 1 day = 24 hours.

steps: Multiply hours by 60 to get minutes.

blocks.explain: There are 60 minutes in one hour.
blocks.rule: 1 hour = 60 minutes, 1 minute = 60 seconds, 1 day = 24 hours.

blocks.content: To change hours to minutes, multiply by 60; to change minutes to hours, divide by 60.

blocks.rule: Multiply hours by 60 to get minutes; divide minutes by 60 to get hours.
